title: DeepSeek Pro gets a larger context
summary:
DeepSeek Pro gained a much larger registered context, Grok’s routing and image accounting were corrected, and the app catalog got a tidy-up.

`deepseek-pro` moved to Fireworks to avoid rate limits on its previous route. Its registered context length increased from 65,536 to 1,048,576 tokens; the regular `deepseek` model remains on DeepInfra.

`grok` was repointed to the Grok 4.20 non-reasoning deployment after its previous route returned upstream 404s. The Grok 4.20 model metadata now lists image input and a 262,144-token context, while usage accounting separates image tokens from text tokens. `grok-large` is marked paid-only.

Existing crypto Pollen was consolidated into pack balances without changing users’ total Pollen. Balance displays and deductions now use the consolidated balance, and the old crypto invoice and webhook routes were removed.

highlights.title: More room for DeepSeek Pro
highlights.text: `deepseek-pro` now has a registered context length of 1,048,576 tokens, up from 65,536. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=deepseek-pro).

highlights.title: Grok 4.20 takes images
highlights.text: Grok 4.20’s reasoning and non-reasoning variants now list text and image input, with a 262,144-token context. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).
